root_cause.primary: all three original worker Machines still used the 2026-08-18 image, which predates the runtime-event instrumentation consumed by the runtime controller and rolling qualification
root_cause.secondary: an old-image upstream job failure inserted incident/recovery evidence; the revision-024 projection trigger then called the revision-026 qualification ingress function, whose hard-coded public.digest was absent in Supabase and raised SQLSTATE 42883 until Fly exhausted ten restarts
root_cause.why_revision_027_alone_was_insufficient: revision 027 removed the terminating secondary exception, but the old worker image still emitted no task lifecycle runtime events and therefore left observe-only recovery and runtime qualification blind
resolved_by: production revision 027 dynamically binds digest to the installed pgcrypto extension namespace
the same three worker Machines were rolled sequentially to the reviewed runtime-event image without changing their non-image configuration
the existing qualification Machine was restarted only after worker and observe-only gates passed

machines.runtime_event_explanation: no quote job was pending during the bounded gate; repeated post-start ticks were healthy idle and shared instrumentation was proved by the other two roles

qualification_gate.interpretation: the prior authorized stop invalidated continuity; the new epoch correctly recovers append-only backlog instead of silently joining the old epoch
